e.title: rate-optimiser
e.summary: 约束费率变更优化（burning-cost，PyPI 0.2.0）：FCA ENBP 约束下的费率变更决策
e.summary_en: Constrained rate change optimiser (burning-cost, PyPI 0.2.0): rate change decisions under FCA ENBP constraints
e.summary_hk: 約束費率變更優化（burning-cost，PyPI 0.2.0）：FCA ENBP 約束下的費率變更決策
e.body: rate-optimiser（burning-cost，PyPI v0.2.0）做约束费率变更优化：FCA ENBP（公平价值）约束下的费率调整决策——英国个人险定价。对 RIAA：费率变更的执行工具——定价手册算好相对数后，实际「涨多少/降多少」是组合优化问题（盈利/市场份额/监管公平约束）；与 [[insurance-optimise]]（组合优化家族）、[[insurance-governance]]（ENBP 监管）配套；适合定价实务与监管合规方向。
e.body_en: rate-optimiser (burning-cost, PyPI v0.2.0) does constrained rate change optimisation: rate adjustment decisions under FCA ENBP (fair value) constraints — UK personal lines. For RIAA: the execution tool of rate changes — after relativities are computed, the actual 'how much to raise/lower' is a portfolio optimisation problem (profit/market-share/regulatory fairness constraints); pairs with [[insurance-optimise]] (optimisation family) and [[insurance-governance]] (ENBP regulation); suits pricing practice and regulatory compliance.
e.body_hk: rate-optimiser（burning-cost，PyPI v0.2.0）做約束費率變更優化：FCA ENBP（公平價值）約束下的費率調整決策——英國個人險定價。對 RIAA：費率變更的執行工具——定價手冊算好相對數後，實際「漲多少/降多少」是組合優化問題（盈利/市場份額/監管公平約束）；與 [[insurance-optimise]]（組合優化家族）、[[insurance-governance]]（ENBP 監管）配套；適合定價實務與監管合規方向。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：PyPI v0.2.0 + GitHub README（家族成员），未实测
